newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka bonds softer tracking Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Markka bonds softer tracking Bunds.

text.p: Bonds were a touch softer in quiet Tuesday afternoon trade tracking Bunds amid EMU jitters, dealers said.

"The market is on edge and fears bad news on EMU, which would mean rising interest rates in peripheral countries," one said. Operators were monitoring European news for clues to the fate of EMU, and also awaiting the U.S. market's opening.
The state treasury's auction of 186- and 193-day T-bills raised 827 million markka.
The markka was steady against the mark with EMU jitters more visible in other DEM crosses, a forex dealer said.
